context7._purpose: Live library/framework documentation lookup. Used by executor (Step 2b), specify, gateway-engineering. No auth required.

serena._purpose: Semantic code navigation via LSP. Used by explore (traversal), analyze, decompose (architecture discovery). Requires uvx (pip install uv).
serena._status: opt-in — install uvx and uncomment to activate

playwright._purpose: Browser automation and E2E testing. Used by test, verifier (Demonstration mode), platform-web, gateway-experience.

github._purpose: GitHub PR/issue management. Used by wave-review (post inline comments), commit, archive (embed PR URL in receipts). Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var.
github._status: opt-in — set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN and uncomment to activate

linear._purpose: Linear issue tracking. Used by recipe (populate task card from ticket), specify, archive (sync completion status). Requires Linear OAuth setup.
linear._status: opt-in — complete Linear OAuth and uncomment to activate
